 This page contains affiliate links. When you purchase through the links provided, we may earn a commission. Getty Images Sport Emanuele Tramacere Oct 25, 2026 13:14-05:00 Translated by Lecce-Juventus 0-2 LIVE: Spalletti takes off Kolo Muani and Cambiaso
 Juventus Lecce Serie A Lecce vs Juventus Follow Lecce-Juventus, the match in the eighth round of Serie A
 Lecce-Juventus kicks off at 18:00 at the Via del Mare in the Salento capital, with three points crucial to both teams and injuries mounting. It is the penultimate match of the eighth round of Serie A 2026/2027. 
 In three days, Eusebio Di Francesco 's Lecce have lost three key starters in Coulibaly, Ilici and Pierotti, but they must maintain their good form. A win would take them above Luciano Spalletti 's Juventus, whose manager is on a "hot seat", as chief executive Carnevali put it. Juventus haven't won either of their last two league matches and have also lost Nico Gonzalez and Celik to injury. They arrive after a controversial Europa League draw against Rennes. 
 Lecce-Juventus 0-2 
 Scorers: 29' McKennie (J), 41' Douglas Luiz (J) 
 Goals and highlights
 63' Lucumì gives the ball away badly. Maleh sets himself on the edge of the box but scuffs his left-footed shot wide. 
 57' - After clearing a corner, Lecce break at pace. Tiago Gabriel plays the ball forward to N'Dri, who immediately crosses towards the centre of the box. The ball deflects off Kalulu and reaches Tiago Gabriel, but the Portuguese defender heads wide. 
 49' CHANCE - Geubbels picks out Maleh with a fine ball. Maleh controls it in the centre of the box and shoots with his left foot, but Gatti makes a crucial deflection to turn it behind for a corner. Vicario then saves Gaspar's header from the resulting corner with ease. 
 46' - Lecce threaten immediately as the ball reaches Ngom on the edge of the box. He scuffs his right-footed shot straight at Vicario in the centre of the goal. 
 41' GOAL - Woltemade controls a fine ball, makes space and launches Juventus forward. Kolo Muani plays it wide to Gatti, who immediately lays it off to Douglas Luiz on the edge of the box. His first-time right-footed shot across goal beats Falcone, who could have done better, with the help of the far post. 
 36' CHANCE - Douglas Luiz plays a ball in behind for Kolo Muani, who gets away from Tiago Gabriel, controls it with his chest and turns. From a slightly wide position, he shoots across goal but scuffs his right-footed effort and misses the far corner. 
 29' GOAL - Douglas Luiz's inventive free-kick routine catches the Lecce defensive line by surprise. McKennie, forgotten by Veiga, times his run to stay onside and stretches to reach the ball. He doesn't make clean contact, but gets enough on it to beat Falcone . 
 25' - Moving the ball from right to left, Lecce break well until it reaches Fatah near the corner of the penalty area. The Swede cuts back on to his right foot, beats Kalulu and curls a shot over Vicario's goal. 
 5' - Woltemade sends Kolo Muani in behind. He reaches the byline and crosses into the centre of the box for the German centre-forward, who miskicks the ball and fails to get a shot away. 
 1' CHANCE - Vicario waits far too long to clear the ball with his feet. When he finally does, N'Dri stretches to intercept it, but the blocked clearance goes behind for a goal kick. 
 0' Kick-off at the Via del Mare is at 6pm

 Substitutes: Bleve, Borbei, Dembelé, Fofana, Stulic, Gandelman, Jean, Esteban, Gorter, Scott.
